rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources together with the Notice to quit or notice of non-renewal. Landlords and foreclosing owners must also submit tenant contact information and a copy of the notice to the City through the online portal.
rules.key_value: Fine of $300 per day for second and subsequent offenses
rules.penalty: First offense: warning; second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day (failure to submit to the City may result in a fine up to $300 per day). Violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.status_basis: Page describes the ordinance as in force, with enforcement by Inspectional Services Department; adoption date not stated.

coverage.summary: Applies to all landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement.

rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
